mechanism: Eslicarbazepine induces CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, reducing propafenone plasma concentrations and antiarrhythmic efficacy while increasing risk of arrhythmia; propafenone may also inhibit eslicarbazepine metabolism, creating bidirectional interaction.
action: Monitor cardiac function and propafenone efficacy closely; propafenone dose adjustment may be necessary; consider alternative antiarrhythmic or anticonvulsant if interaction cannot be managed.
